extracted.name: Oatmeal banana waffles (no flour needed)
extracted.description: This is a delicious breakfast recipe if you are craving some sweets and maintain healthy eating. You would need a waffle maker and a food processor for this recipe. I use a ninja bullet. Tips 💡Add collagen powder when you're preparing your dry mix. 💡If you don't want bananas, use 2 cups of oats
ingredient_lines: 1 2/3 cup milk or plant based milk or water (all options work for me)
instruction_lines: Add the rolled oats to the blender and keep going until they become like an oat flour.
Add all wet ingredients to separate mixing bowl and whisk them.
In a separate bowl, add in all dry ingredients including flour alike oats and stir them well.
Pour the wet ingredient/banana mix to the bowl that has the dry mix.
Whisk them until you get a smooth texture. Add the mashed bananas into the mixture and stir them
Heat the waffle maker and spray oil.
Pour the mixture on the waffle maker and wait until cooked
